LESSON: FREE-HAND SKETCHING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Communication in Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 2.2: Free-hand sketching

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Free-hand sketching. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is free- hand sketching important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the principles of free-hand sketching
2. Identify techniques of free-hand sketching

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the principles of free-hand sketching
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the principles of free-hand sketching. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Identify techniques of free-hand sketching
   In simple words: practise until you can identify techniques of free-hand sketching. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Free-hand sketching using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Free-hand sketching in the examples.
2. Explain Free-hand sketching to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Free-hand sketching.
4. Show that you can: Explain the principles of free-hand sketching

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Free-hand sketching using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Free-hand sketching important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the meaning of free-hand sketching as used in Pre-Technical Studies,
2. Communication and Collaboration: learner acquires speaking, listening, and teamwork skills when discussing the meaning of free-hand sketching as used in Pre-Technical Studies.
3. Digital Literacy: learner develops the skill of interacting with technology when using digital media to observe how free-hand sketches express artistic ideas in different career fields. Values:
4. Respect: learner demonstrates etiquette during discussion of the meaning of free-hand sketching as used in Pre-Technical Studies

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the principles of free-hand sketching
2. Identify techniques of free-hand sketching

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
